effects.label: Fente perçante
effects.subject: A thin horizontal dimensional tear passing straight LEFT TO RIGHT through the centre. Dark violet outer edge, narrow brilliant white core, two cyan-violet parallel speed threads extending beyond the white cut. Absolutely no vertical blade, no diagonal slash, no creature. Frames 1-2 anticipate with violet threads, 3-4 cut left-to-right through the target centre, 5-6 short dissipating fragments.

effects.label: Éclats de stase
effects.subject: A SMALL open faceted cyan crystal cage indicating vulnerability around an unseen enemy. No enemy drawn. Frost cracks appear on crystal facets then settle into a frozen fractured crystal outline. Very hollow centre, fine bright cyan cracks, violet lower-right facets. Frames 1-3 small crystal fragments materialise, 4-5 frost cracks propagate, 6-8 the cracked open crystal outline settles and stays readable. The last frame is intentionally settled, not an explosion or a fade to empty.

effects.label: Concentration
effects.subject: ONE heavy cyan crystal falling vertically, strikes central ground point in a compact white-cyan star impact then a SMALL elliptical violet-cyan ground shockwave. Frames 1-3 thick falling cyan streak above centre, frame4 contact, frames5-6 starburst and hollow ellipse, frames7-8 sparse fading crystal fragments. Ground ellipse height/width 0.7, stable impact centre.

effects.label: Traque
effects.subject: A small violet target-lock sigil around an invisible enemy. A thin purple ring contracts neatly inward, then a small white-violet spark shoots STRAIGHT UP toward the permanent mark above it. Frames1-4 contracting hollow ring, frames5-6 upward spark, frames7-8 fading tiny violet motes. No horizontal travelling projectile, no drawn enemy.

effects.label: Contrecoup
effects.subject: An enemy projectile dissolves into a SMALL puff of dark grey-violet ash, followed by ONE tiny GOLD-GREEN healing spark rising upward from it. Frames1-3 small pale projectile dissolving into ash, frames4-6 tiny warm gold mint-green spark rising, frames7-8 fade. Minimal compact effect, no hands, no shield, no human, no red or orange.

effects.label: Exécution
effects.subject: A violet execution seal closes into ONE vertical energy blade dropping on the central unseen target, a WHITE-VIOLET contact flash at frames6-7, dark purple crystal fragments falling away at frames8-12. Frames1-4 collapsing seal, frames5-7 descending blade and brief flash, frames8-12 diminishing falling fragments. No physical weapon or human, only energy sigil and blade. Final frame almost empty.

effects.label: Ombre piégée
effects.subject: A ground shadow trap: flattened dark-violet elliptical outline at fixed centre explodes outward, thin violet tendrils or short SHADOW CHAINS remain for exactly frames7-9 then fade in10-12. No hands or creature. The ellipse height/width is0.7. Clearly outlined rim, centre mostly empty transparent, NO OPAQUE FILL INSIDE THE ELLIPSE. Frames1-3 gathering shadow,4-6 outward burst,7-9 short entangling shadow chains,10-12 fade.

effects.label: Orage
effects.subject: A SEAMLESS LOOP of tiny prismatic cyan and violet crystal shards orbiting along the rim of ONE flattened ground ellipse, height/width0.7. Stable ellipse and centre in all8frames. A clear thin broken rim made of small faceted shards. The interior is COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT EMPTY negative space. No central glow, no filled disk, no rain columns, no red/orange, no white flash. Shards advance gradually around the ellipse in a repeatable cycle; frame8 naturally joins frame1 with same scale and brightness.
